summary: Frontend-only theme regression test of Glint (Black & Golden lockdown). Verified via public preview URL with mobile viewport (375x667), computed-style background assertions + screenshots. RESULT: theme fix is effective — every tested screen renders black backgrounds with gold accents: Welcome rgb(0,0,0), Login rgb(0,0,0), Home feed rgb(0,0,0)/cards rgb(15,15,15), Chats rgb(0,0,0), Chat detail rgb(0,0,0), Profile rgb(0,0,0), Settings rgb(0,0,0), Admin login rgb(26,26,26 input area)/black root, Admin dashboard black with gold active chip + gold 'Reply & resolve' CTA. Gold accents confirmed: FAB '+' rgb(234,179,8)=#EAB308, gold Glint logo, gold active tab icon, gold admin chips/CTAs, white headings + grey subtext. src/theme.ts now uses a single 'glint' palette (surface #000000, surfaceSecondary #0F0F0F, brandPrimary #EAB308, brandSecondary #D97706) assigned to BOTH themes.light and themes.dark — theme is truly locked. Theme toggle UI removed from Settings (verified absent). Bug-vector test PASSED: localStorage glint_theme_mode='system' + emulated OS light preference still renders black (rgb(15,15,15)). Regression: login na@test.com/secret123 works, feed loads posts (Notif Alice, TESTA User), all 4 tabs navigate, settings opens, admin login admin@glint.app/GlintAdmin@2026 works, dashboard tab switching (Tickets->Users) works, user search renders. NEW FINDING: React Navigation default light theme card background rgb(242,242,242) sits under every screen (Stack has no custom nav theme in _layout.tsx) — invisible today but can flash during slide transitions; likely the original white-flash vector.

ui_bugs.issue: React Navigation DefaultTheme (light) paints every screen card background rgb(242,242,242) — a full-screen absolute div (css-view r-position-u8s1d, 375x667) sits under all screens incl. admin dashboard. Currently masked by opaque black screen roots, but can flash white-ish during slide_from_right transitions or if any screen root is non-opaque. This is very likely the residual source of the user-reported bright-white flashes.
<body>/<html> have no background-color (transparent) — before React hydrates, the web preview paints browser-default white (flash on cold load). Add background:#000000 to body style.

Outfit/Figtree fonts loaded from jsdelivr CDN at runtime; first test run hit 'Failed to load font Ionicons - 12000ms timeout' which blocked screenshots and can leave icons broken on slow networks. Second run loaded fine (7 fonts, Ionicons:loaded). Consider bundling fonts as local assets.

action_items: Wrap app in @react-navigation/native ThemeProvider with a custom dark nav theme ({...DarkTheme, colors: {...DarkTheme.colors, background:'#000000', card:'#000000', primary:'#EAB308', text:'#FFFFFF', border:'#262626'}}) in app/_layout.tsx, OR set Stack screenOptions contentStyle:{backgroundColor:'#000000'} to eliminate the rgb(242,242,242) card layer under screens.
Add backgroundColor '#000000' to <body> style in app/+html.tsx to prevent white flash before hydration.

Optional cleanup: ThemeModeContext still exposes setMode('light')/toggle (dead code now that themes.light===themes.dark) and settings.tsx retains unused themeRow/themeBtn/themeText styles — safe to remove.
Optional reliability: bundle Outfit/Figtree fonts locally instead of jsdelivr CDN to avoid font-load timeouts breaking icons/screenshots.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG RCA: Two residual white-flash vectors remain after the palette lock, both verified live: (1) expo-router Stack uses @react-navigation DefaultTheme whose light colors.background = rgb(242,242,242); every screen card gets this background (confirmed via computed style of a full-screen absolute css-view on the admin dashboard). Screen roots currently cover it, but during slide_from_right transitions or on any non-opaque screen it shows as bright white — matching the user report. MITIGATION: pass custom dark navigation theme via ThemeProvider or Stack screenOptions contentStyle {backgroundColor:'#000000'}. (2) Web <body> has no background (transparent), so browser-default white shows before JS hydration on cold load. MITIGATION: set body backgroundColor '#000000' in app/+html.tsx. The core palette fix itself (themes.light === themes.dark === black/gold glint palette) is CONFIRMED CORRECT and all screens measure black with gold accents.
